title: Reports
description: Scheduled summary reports (availability and SLA, credentials, runs) and the archive of generated PDF reports.

presetHints.daily: Every day at 06:00 about the previous day.
presetHints.weekly: Every Monday at 06:00 about the previous week (Monday to Sunday).
presetHints.monthly: On the 1st at 06:00 about the previous month.
presetHints.custom: Your cron expression (five fields: minute hour day month weekday; at most once an hour); the report covers the given number of days before each run.

availability.title: Availability of monitors
availability.hint: Uptime, outages and response times per monitor, with an optional SLA target

gatus.title: Availability of Gatus endpoints
gatus.hint: From the metrics Steward scrapes from Gatus (metrics mode)

credentials.title: Credentials register
credentials.hint: Expired and overdue entries, and those due soon

runs.title: Runs
runs.hint: Succeeded and failed runs per process

records.title: Records and change requests
records.hint: Records created, changed, approved or implemented; open change requests by status; planned change windows

deleteConfirm: Delete the report schedule "{{name}}"? Reports generated so far stay in the archive.
noReports: No summary or scheduled reports yet.

form.name: Name
form.title: Report title
form.titleHint: Printed on the cover; default: the name
form.ownerRights: The report runs with your rights: it only contains what you may see. Recipients see the report, not the data behind it.
form.noGatus: Turn on metrics mode for a Gatus platform first (Platform → Metrics).
form.windowDays: Change windows up to (days after the period)
form.windowDaysHint: Planned change windows from the start of the period until this many days after its end
form.emailsHint: Get the report by e-mail only (when e-mail is set up). Up to 20 addresses; their domain must be allowed in Settings → Notifications. Press Enter after each address.
form.attachPdfHint: Otherwise the e-mail contains a link (recipients need an account to open it).

emptyState.title: No report schedules yet
emptyState.text: Send a summary PDF (availability, credentials, runs, records) to your team every week or month.
